---
name: Integration request
about: Ask for support for an agent, framework, model SDK or witness
labels: integration
---

**What should Tracekit integrate with?** (name, link, version)

**How does it expose tool calls?** (hooks, callbacks, middleware, OpenTelemetry, a proxy, nothing)

**Where does it run?** (laptop, CI, a server-hosted agent) and who controls the process

**What you need from the integration** (capture only, policy gating, approvals, bundles)
